reporting_policy: Report dimensions separately. Weighted final score is optional and secondary.

core_metrics.name: execution_pass_rate
core_metrics.description: Whether generated code executes and produces expected render artifacts.

core_metrics.name: visual_fidelity
core_metrics.description: Overall visual similarity to the target scientific panel.

core_metrics.name: chart_type_consistency
core_metrics.description: Whether primary and secondary chart types match the target.

core_metrics.name: layout_consistency
core_metrics.description: Whether subplot, inset, legend, annotation, and spatial arrangement match.

core_metrics.name: data_pattern_fidelity
core_metrics.description: Whether trends, distributions, relative values, curves, heatmap structure, and error bars match.

core_metrics.name: text_label_fidelity
core_metrics.description: Whether titles, labels, tick text, legend text, and annotations are complete and correct.

core_metrics.name: axis_fidelity
core_metrics.description: Whether axis range, scale type, ticks, units, and labels match.

core_metrics.name: legend_colorbar_completeness
core_metrics.description: Whether legends and colorbars are present, correct, visible, and placed properly.

core_metrics.name: component_completeness
core_metrics.description: Whether key components such as error bars, fit lines, confidence intervals, significance markers, reference lines, and insets are present.

core_metrics.name: clarity_overlap
core_metrics.description: Whether the figure is readable without damaging overlaps, clipping, or edge loss.

core_metrics.name: scientific_notation_fidelity
core_metrics.description: Whether Greek letters, superscripts/subscripts, units, gene/protein names, formulas, and mathematical symbols are rendered correctly.

core_metrics.name: code_validity_editability
core_metrics.description: Whether the code is a meaningful editable plotting program instead of image copying or raster tracing.

invalidity_metrics.name: direct_image_dependency_rate
invalidity_metrics.description: Rate of samples where generated code loads or edits target/source/reproduction images.

invalidity_metrics.name: pixel_painting_or_raster_tracing_rate
invalidity_metrics.description: Rate of samples where generated code paints pixels or traces raster regions instead of using meaningful data or plotting primitives.
